events.title: Bessos claims the kingship
events.description: At Bactra, Bessos assumes the royal name Artaxerxes V.
events.precisionNote: The source places this episode in autumn. The map marks the city, not a precise location within it.

events.title: Alexander enters Bactria
events.description: Alexander invades Bactria in pursuit of Bessos.
events.precisionNote: The evidence gives a season, not an exact date. Alexander’s location is known at regional level here; no personal position is plotted.

events.title: Bactra falls to Alexander’s forces
events.description: Bessos retreats across the Oxus into Sogdia, and his capital, Bactra, falls.
events.precisionNote: This event is associated with the invasion of 329 BCE. No exact day is asserted.

historicalOverlays.label: Bactria
historicalOverlays.subtitle: Approximate heartland

displayWindow.meaning: Prototype presentation window, not proof of unchanged boundaries in each year.

historicalOverlays.method: Original coarse orientation sketch of the southern heartland. Northern edge loosely follows the modern Amu Darya/Panj reference; southern edge approximates the Hindu Kush. East and west edges are illustrative closures. Not traced from a published historical map.
historicalOverlays.limitations: Not the complete satrapy, a surveyed frontier, or a reconstruction for a particular day. Northern Bactria beyond the river is omitted. Ancient river courses and the limits of the region are uncertain.

contexts.precisionNote: Period context, not an event dated to the selected year. Some chronologies begin the Warring States period in 475 BCE. The marker is a regional reference, not a capital or border.
